courses.title: Professional Beautician Training
courses.shortDescription: Live online training in professional beautician training for women who want practical, home-friendly skills.
courses.description: LIVE ONLINE TRAINING – NOT A RECORDED COURSE. This one-month Zoom programme focuses on practical home-based vocational and local business skills. You will attend four live classes each week, complete practical exercises and take part in question-and-answer sessions with the instructor. Designed for home-based service businesses such as beauty, stitching, baking or photography that can serve local customers. Intakes are planned for the 1st of every month. Exact class days and timings are shared with registered participants after enrolment. Classes are interactive; this is not a pre-recorded video course.
courses.schedule: Four live classes per week. Exact class days and timings will be shared with registered participants.
learningOutcomes: Demonstrate core techniques of the skill area
Prepare a simple service or product offer
Price home-based services for local clients
Present work samples to potential customers
requirements: Smartphone or computer with a stable internet connection
Willingness to attend scheduled live Zoom sessions
Space and basic materials suited to the skill (where relevant)
